decision.observation: 2 mph, gear 1, all dots dark, red X lit. The camera swung slightly; the car is still on grass right of the lane with the Nimkäädel arch up-left, the barrel row and EXHAUST banners left, and a clear grassy corridor ahead along the car's heading.
decision.hypothesis: The short left steer cost most of the speed again without gaining the lane. Plain W reliably rebuilds speed on this grass; then a left steer attempted from higher speed and at a better moment should work.
decision.memory: One-dot/two-dot W-steer cycles here just bleed 7 mph to 2 mph. Build to 10+ mph with a plain W first.
